_comment: Thresholds and rules for pa_basics.py and pa_basics_tab.py. Everything tunable lives here — nothing is hardcoded in logic files.
_pivot_window_n_note: Fractal pivot window. With N=2, high/low must exceed 2 bars on either side. Confirmed at bar t+N.
_use_close_for_trendline_note: True = use close prices at pivots to eliminate wick noise per source method; False = use extreme wicks (high/low).
_trendline_touch_tolerance_pts_note: Distance in points from the line to count as a valid touch / bounce.
_trendline_fake_break_max_bars_note: If a break reverses back through the trendline within this many bars, tag as FAKE BREAK.
_rsi_overbought_note: Overbought threshold. Note: Overbought is NOT RSI > 70; it is crossing back down from 70.
_rsi_oversold_note: Oversold threshold. Note: Oversold is NOT RSI < 30; it is crossing back up from 30.
_rsi_neutral_mid_note: Above 50 = bullish bias; Below 50 = bearish bias.
_rsi_cross_lookback_bars_note: Window of recent bars to detect the crossing back through 70 or 30.
_atr_period_note: Wilder's ATR period if not pre-computed in dataframe.
_atr_stop_multiplier_1_note: First suggested stop distance multiplier. Source: 1 ATR is no longer enough.
_atr_stop_multiplier_2_note: Second suggested stop distance multiplier for wide volatility regimes.
_fixed_15m_stop_pts_note: Existing Strategy 1 reference stop on 15m chart. Shown alongside ATR, never replacing it.
_lot_size_note: NIFTY lot size (65 in 2026). Used for rupee risk per lot display.
_pattern_equal_tolerance_pct_note: Max percentage difference between pivot levels to consider them equal (e.g. 0.18% of 24000 = ~43 pts).
_zone_half_width_pts_note: Half-width of S/R bands in points (support and resistance are zones, not thin lines).
